author: MuzzBuzz
body:
Hi,

I recently got tempbanned for 10 days. I will admit it was fair, however I was not warned or kicked beforehand.

I admit what I was doing was wrong, and I sincerely apologise. Please unban me. I swear I will never offend again, no matter what my infractions might suggest.

Cheers,
Keaton

title: Tempban Appeal

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Hello,

You used racist words towards me in /msg and you know exactly what you said, not forgetting spamming the chat with heavy language. The reason it was a straight up 10 day ban was the amount of past infractions you've gained, have a look at the list then think wether or not you should be banned.

Regards,
Blizzem_

You don't need to be warned or kicked, due to the fact that you have previous infractions for disrespect. You have not learned a lesson from your last temp ban, therefore you will not be appealed.

Regards,
